Container.Name: Simple Finance Multi-household
Container.Overview:
Private finance app for multiple separate households. Each household has one or two members, its own SQLite database and its own documents directory. The administrator pre-assigns Cloudflare-authenticated email identities before first sign-in; there is no self-sign-up. Cross-household financial access is denied unless that household explicitly grants a visible, time-limited, audited support session.
Cloudflare Tunnel + Access (Google sign-in) is required. Keep this container off the public internet. This is a separate appdata directory, image and host port from the original Simple Finance installation.
Container.Description: Simple Finance Multi-household. Stable image: ghcr.io/dougalbob/simple-finance-multi-household:latest. v1.29.0 is the stable production release and moves :latest. On Charts, a Sync to Spending mix toggle on Spending trends makes each month bar set the Spending mix to that whole month with the preset's categories, signposted and fully resettable; the trends verdict now compares with the month before it. Internal port 3000; host port 3009. New data root: /mnt/user/appdata/simple-finance-multi-household. Do not use the original appdata path or original image.

Config.Name: WebUI (host port)
Config.Description: Host port 3009 is reserved for the new multi-household container; the container listens on 3000. Cloudflare Tunnel's new route points here. Keep the original route on host port 3007.

Config.Name: Appdata (/data)
Config.Description: Separate root for this product line. Contains .env, system registry, and households/<id>/ databases and documents. Never point it at /mnt/user/appdata/simple-finance.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data directory. Unraid's nobody is 99; the entrypoint aligns ownership once, then the app runs as this user (never root).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data directory. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: AUTH_ISSUER
Config.Description: Cloudflare Access team URL, e.g. https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com. Optional here — values in /data/.env override the template.

Config.Name: AUTH_AUDIENCE
Config.Description: The new Cloudflare Access application's AUD tag. Optional here — values in /data/.env override the template.

Config.Name: AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS
Config.Description: Transitional only for inherited single-household code. Final household assignment is managed in the app registry; do not use this variable as the onboarding process.
